label: The MTBF formula
subgoals: Write the metastability event rate as T0 f_clk f_data
Model the probability of not resolving as e^(-t/tau)
Combine them into MTBF = e^(t_r/tau) / (T0 f_clk f_data)

label: Computing MTBF
subgoals: Compute the denominator T0 f_clk f_data in events per second
Compute the exponent t_r over tau
Divide e^(t_r/tau) by the denominator and convert units

label: Adding stages and designing to a target
section: Adding stages and designing to a target
subgoals: Multiply MTBF by e^(T/tau) for each added stage
Solve t_r = tau ln(MTBF T0 f_clk f_data) for a target
Divide the system MTBF target by the number of synchronizers
